newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express March load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express March load factor off.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Wednesday the March load factor for its Midwest Express Airlines operation fell 1.6 points to 67.7 percent from 69.3 percent a year earlier.
Revenue passenger miles rose 13.4 percent to 125.5 million from 110.7 million, and available seat miles increased 16 percent to 185.4 million from 159.8 million.

Year to date, the load factor fell 3.1 points to 60.2 percent from 63.3 percent in 1996. Revenue passenger miles advanced 7.2 percent to 313.4 million from 292.3 million, and available seat miles rose 12.7 percent to 520.3 million.

The company's Skyway Airlines operation saw its March load factor decline two points to 44.0 percent from 46 percent. Revenue passenger miles fell 2.3 percent to 5.9 million, and available seat miles increased 2.0 percent to 13.4 million.

Year to date, Skyway Airlines' load factor slipped 1.6 points to 40.9 percent. Its revenue passenger miles fell 4.8 percent to 15.8 million, and its available seat miles were down 1.1 percent to 38.7 million.
